hero.tagline: Automate and enhance your live production
hero.description: Prepare rundowns, design HTML graphics and drive your whole show from a single live context, wired to Companion and Node-RED.

features.title: Everything the control room needs
features.description: One place to prepare the show, and one source of truth while it's on air.

rundowns.title: Rundowns
rundowns.description: Plan your shows step by step, then follow them live from a dedicated view.

graphics.title: HTML graphics
graphics.description: Build CG layers with HTML and Tailwind, preview them at any resolution and load them as a browser source in your playout software.

context.title: Live context engine
context.description: A shared JSON state pushed in real time over SSE, with validators, mutators and version history.

companion.title: Companion module
companion.description: Bind Stream Deck buttons and triggers to the context: watch values, set them, react to changes.

node_red.title: Node-RED flows
node_red.description: Dedicated nodes to read and write the context, so any device or API can join the automation.

team.title: Team and media
team.description: Roles and permissions for every operator, and network drives as media sources.

how_it_works.title: How it works
how_it_works.description: From preparation to air, everything flows through the context.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.description: Write the rundown, design the graphics layers and plug in your media sources.

connect.title: Connect
connect.description: Point Companion, Node-RED or any HTTP client at the context engine.

go_live.title: Go live
go_live.description: Every change to the context updates graphics and devices instantly, on every screen.

cta.title: Ready to take control?
cta.description: Self-host ONVEP MCR with Docker and run your next show from it.
